description: Utilities for in-memory key-value storage. Provides a built-in key-value store for sharing data between services running on the same machine, with optional expiration support.

instructions.description: Writes to local key-value store. The value will be available to all services running on the same machine.
instructions.name: Write to KV

parameters.description: Used to set relative expiration time expressed as number of milliseconds
parameters.name: expiration

instructions.description: Increments a numeric value in the key-value store. If the key doesn't exist, it will be created with the increment value. If the key exists but is not a number, an error will be thrown.
instructions.name: Increment

parameters.description: Used to set relative expiration time expressed as number of milliseconds
parameters.name: expiration

instructions.description: Reads value from a local key-value store. If the key is not found, the action will save a `null` value.
instructions.name: Read from KV

instructions.description: Deletes value from a local key-value store. If the key is not found, the action will do nothing.
instructions.name: Delete from KV
